jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(B) inventory: Canaan School District, a town school district in the Essex North Supervisory Union (member town: Canaan).
Essex North Supervisory Union (official site hosting the district's board page).

sources.note: Town of Canaan Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 annual town and school district election (official, posted by the town): Raelene Begin elected to the 3-year SCHOOL DIRECTOR seat (95 votes); Renee Marchesseault (98) and Martha Vanderwolk (85) elected to the two 2-year seats.

Town of Canaan 2025 Town Report, officers list: five School Directors in the section 423(a)-(b) shape (three 3-year seats, two 2-year seats) -- Raelene Begin, Terrie Herr (3-year term ending 2027), Kristie Begin (2028), Martha Vanderwolk, Renee Marchesseault. The district's March 9, 2026 reorganization minutes seat the same five (with Kristie Begin's membership held in this build -- see the district report on issue #163).
